title: Global Well-Posedness of the Kuramoto--Sivashinsky Equation in One and Two Dimensions under a Codimension-One Constraint
summary: We study the Kuramoto--Sivashinsky (KS) equation in one, two, and three spatial dimensions subject to a codimension-one constraint. The constraint preserves the \(L^2\)-norm of the solution and consequently provides a uniform a priori bound that plays a central role in the higher-order energy estimates. In one spatial dimension, we establish global well-posedness by means of a Fourier--Galerkin approximation and compactness arguments.
